FOREIGN KEY (categoria_id) REFERENCES retail.categorias(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (categoria_id) REFERENCES retail.categorias(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (((vigente_desde IS NULL) OR (vigente_hasta IS NULL) OR (vigente_desde <= vigente_hasta)))
CHECK (((tipo <> 'factura'::text) OR ((cliente_tipo_doc = 'ruc'::text) AND (cliente_num_doc IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((tipo <> ALL (ARRAY['nota_credito'::text, 'nota_debito'::text])) OR ((comprobante_original_id IS NOT NULL) AND (motivo IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((estado = ANY (ARRAY['pendiente'::text, 'no_emitido'::text])) OR (entorno_transmision IS NOT NULL))) NOT VALID
CHECK ((((alcance = 'categoria'::text) AND (alcance_categoria_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((alcance = 'todo'::text) AND (alcance_categoria_id IS NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (sububicacion_id, ubicacion_id) REFERENCES retail.sububicaciones(id, ubicacion_id)
CHECK ((((estado = 'pendiente'::text) AND (aprobado_en IS NULL)) OR ((estado <> 'pendiente'::text) AND (aprobado_en IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (categoria_id) REFERENCES retail.categorias(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (((vigente_desde IS NULL) OR (vigente_hasta IS NULL) OR (vigente_desde <= vigente_hasta)))
FOREIGN KEY (sububicacion_destino_id, ubicacion_destino_id) REFERENCES retail.sububicaciones(id, ubicacion_id)
FOREIGN KEY (sububicacion_id, ubicacion_id) REFERENCES retail.sububicaciones(id, ubicacion_id)

CHECK ((((tipo = 'traslado'::text) AND (ubicacion_destino_id IS NOT NULL) AND ((ubicacion_destino_id <> ubicacion_id) OR (sububicacion_destino_id IS DISTINCT FROM sububicacion_id))) OR ((tipo <> 'traslado'::text) AND (ubicacion_destino_id IS NULL))))
CHECK (((tipo <> 'ajuste'::text) OR ((motivo IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM motivo)) > 0))))

CHECK ((((tipo = ANY (ARRAY['consumo'::text, 'devolucion'::text])) AND (produccion_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((tipo = ANY (ARRAY['compra'::text, 'merma'::text, 'ajuste'::text])) AND (produccion_id IS NULL))))

CHECK ((((estado = 'en_cuarentena'::text) AND (movimiento_salida_id IS NULL) AND (resuelto_en IS NULL)) OR ((estado <> 'en_cuarentena'::text) AND (movimiento_salida_id IS NOT NULL) AND (resuelto_en IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK ((((estado = 'terminada'::text) AND (cantidad_buenas IS NOT NULL)) OR ((estado <> 'terminada'::text) AND (cantidad_buenas IS NULL) AND (inventariado_at IS NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (marca_id, proveedor_id) REFERENCES retail.marca_proveedores(marca_id, proveedor_id)
CHECK ((((tipo = 'nota_credito'::text) AND (nota_credito_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((tipo = 'aplicacion'::text) AND (compra_pago_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((tipo = 'reembolso'::text) AND (metodo IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((billeteras IS NULL) OR (((cardinality(billeteras) >= 1) AND (cardinality(billeteras) <= 2)) AND (billeteras <@ ARRAY['yape'::text, 'plin'::text]))))
FOREIGN KEY (sububicacion_id, ubicacion_id) REFERENCES retail.sububicaciones(id, ubicacion_id)
UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (variante_id, ubicacion_id, sububicacion_id)
FOREIGN KEY (variante_id) REFERENCES retail.variantes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK ((((descuento_unitario = (0)::numeric) AND (motivo_descuento IS NULL)) OR ((descuento_unitario > (0)::numeric) AND (motivo_descuento IS NOT NULL)))) NOT VALID
CHECK (((motivo_descuento IS DISTINCT FROM 'otro'::text) OR ((motivo_descuento_detalle IS NOT NULL) AND (btrim(motivo_descuento_detalle) <> ''::text)))) NOT VALID

CHECK ((((estado = 'completada'::text) AND (anulado_en IS NULL) AND (motivo_anulacion IS NULL) AND (anulado_por IS NULL)) OR ((estado = 'anulada'::text) AND (anulado_en IS NOT NULL) AND (motivo_anulacion IS NOT NULL))))
